description: This file defines data models and sealed classes related to authentication state and session management within an Android application, including classes for representing authentication lifecycle states, session tokens, operation results, and error types.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Represents the overall authentication lifecycle state used by UI/ViewModels, including LoggedOut, Locked, and Unlocked states.

classes.name: LockReason
classes.description: Enumerates reasons why the session might be locked, such as user initiation, app backgrounding, biometric requirement, or token expiry.

classes.name: SessionTokens
classes.description: Data class that encapsulates access and refresh tokens along with expiry information, including a utility method to check token expiry.

classes.name: AuthResult
classes.description: Contains the session tokens and server message returned from login or token refresh operations.

classes.name: AuthOpResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing the result of authentication operations, including Success and Failure variants.

classes.name: AuthError
classes.description: Sealed class for error types in authentication process, safely encapsulating error messages and optional cause

methods.name: isAccessTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the access token has expired based on the provided current epoch milliseconds.
